decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated five backpacks based on capacity, durability, and user feedback. The SHENHU 40L (prod_backpacks_111) and W WINTMING 45L (prod_backpacks_164) offered good capacity but had some concerns regarding buckle and zipper durability in the reviews. The ZOMAKE (prod_backpacks_173) is an excellent lightweight option but too minimal for a primary pack. The High Sierra 70L (prod_backpacks_068) is a quality internal-frame pack but too large for general use. I chose the Maxpedition Prepared Citizen Classic (prod_backpacks_038) because of its exceptional 4.7 rating and customer praise for its heavy-duty material and discrete 'nondescript' design, which makes it versatile for both professional environments and outdoor trekking.
